newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Oct 28.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Oct 28.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

The ANZ Banking Group Ltd and the London-based Standard Chartered Plc are investigating a A$24 billion stock merger along the lines of the December 1995 RTZ-CRA stock swap, The Australian Financial Review newspaper said on Monday. The newspaper said the two banks had engaged Goldman Sachs and SBC Warburg to advise on the structure of the deal. Spokesmen for ANZ and SBC Warburg later said they were not in a position to comment on the report.

Standard & Poor's on Friday night assigned its triple-B'-minus rating to News Corp. Exchange Trust's proposed US$1 billion (liquidation value) exchange preferred securities, which carry a limited guarantee by News Corp. Ltd. But it also lowered its rating on News Corp. Ltd.'s US$400 million (liquidation value) preference stock to triple-B'-minus-r from triple-B'-r, and its rating on Newscorp Overseas Ltd.'s US$345 million (liquidation value) preference stock to triple-B'-minus from triple-B'. At the same time, Standard & Poor's affirmed its triple-B' corporate credit rating on News Corp. Ltd. and its units.

MIM Holdings Ltd said late on Friday a strike over award conditions by workers at its Oaky Creek coal mine in north Queensland which began on Thursday will go before an Industrial Relations Commission hearing on Monday.

Santos Ltd said late on Friday it made a new field discovery in the South Australian section of the onshore Cooper/Eromanga basin with the Gudi One wildcat well flowing 224,000 cubic metres of gas a day and 150 barrels of condensate.

Australian building materials analysts said on Friday they plan to downgrade their 1996/97 earnings forecasts for Pioneer International Ltd due to the poor first quarter performance and the company's downward revision to its outlook for the current year.

Westgold Resources NL said on Monday it has acquired 20.12 million shares in Bolnisi Gold NL representing 14.99 percent of Bolnisi's capital. Westgold, which is involved in a merger with Ramsgate Resources NL, said it acquired the shares on the market on Friday at a price of 16 cents each.

Anaconda Nickel NL said on Monday it had issued 7.2 million shares to Swiss commodity trading house Glencore International AG at A$3.38 per share to raise A$24.336 million for the development its Murrin Murrin nickel-cobalt project in Western Australia.

Premier Oil Plc said late on Friday it will decide next week on a possible rise in its takeover bid for Discovery Petroleum NL if the Australian oil producer and explorer can prove that its assets are worth more.
